compatibility.public_field_union: existing standard plus retained FMP Data; no added fields
compatibility.query_change: New bounded FMP variant; one required symbol, strict extras. Other providers unchanged.

incompatibilities.retained_source_defect: reportedCurrency mapped to undeclared currency and was lost.
incompatibilities.approved_correction: Map to existing reported_currency; no new fields.

incompatibilities.retained_source_defect: Growth x-unit_measurement=percent plus x-frontend_multiply=100 selects native normalizedPercent and multiplies fractions for presentation.
incompatibilities.approved_correction: Provider declarations override all growth fields to x-unit_measurement=ratio and remove x-frontend_multiply in both schema modes; existing field union and numeric fractions unchanged.
incompatibilities.migration: Native widget formatter projects numeric ratio columns without percent multiplication; standards remain unchanged.

limitations: No live calls; account entitlement and consumer behavior unverified.
Not point-in-time safe; publication/vintage and restatement unknown.
Empty array succeeds distinctly from unavailable optional values and response validation failure.
Currency is not inferred from symbol, exchange or profile.
Provider calculation; source denominator periods, duration and restatement unverified.
Balance growth compares stocks; flow growth does not establish discrete quarter versus YTD.
reported_currency identifies reporting currency context; fractions are dimensionless.
Retained percent/multiply100 schema instructions are overridden to ratio with no frontend multiply; native formatter preserves fractions.
Public limit20 (1..100) replaces archived implicit5; one request, no paging.
Ten retained growth fields required-but-nullable: omission fails; explicit null remains missing.

parameters.period: annual and quarter documented among wider provider choices; this variant restricts to annual/quarter

source_evidence.source_values: Official example returns signed fractional growth values; preserved at ratio scale 1. No multiplication by 100.
source_evidence.fiscal_aliases: calendarYear retained alias; fiscalYear generated native alias also accepted into fiscal_year.
